question_text:
The table alongside shows the probability distribution for $X$.

$$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline x & 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 \\\hline P(X = x) & 0.3 & 0.2 & m & n \\\hline\end{array}$$

If $E(X) = 1.55$, find $m$ and $n$.

subparts.stem:
The table alongside shows the probability distribution for $X$.

$$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline x & 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 \\\hline P(X = x) & 0.3 & 0.2 & m & n \\\hline\end{array}$$

If $E(X) = 1.55$, find $m$ and $n$.

mark_breakdown.desc: Use $\sum P(x_i) = 1$ to write equation relating $m$ and $n$
Use $E(X) = 1.55$ to write second equation in $m$ and $n$

subparts.solution:
Since this is a probability distribution, $\sum_{i=1}^n P(x_i) = 1$
$\therefore 0.3 + 0.2 + m + n = 1$
$\therefore n = 0.5 - m \quad \dots (*)$

Now if $E(X) = 1.55$, then $1.55 = \sum_{i=1}^n x_i p_i$
$\therefore 1.55 = 0(0.3) + 1(0.2) + 2m + 3n$
$\therefore 1.35 = 2m + 3(0.5 - m) \quad \{\text{using } (*)\}$
$\therefore 1.35 = 2m + 1.5 - 3m$
$\therefore -0.15 = -m$
$\therefore m = 0.15$

Substituting into $(*)$, $n = 0.5 - 0.15 = 0.35$.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Form two linear equations in two unknowns using $\sum P(X=x) = 1$ and $E(X) = \sum x P(X=x)$, then solve simultaneously.
step_by_step: Total probability equation: $0.3 + 0.2 + m + n = 1 \implies m + n = 0.5$, so $n = 0.5 - m$.
